verdict.rationale: A live probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI document at https://docs.vast.ai/api/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key). It describes the documented REST API, which is the foundation of the CLI and SDK and gives programmatic control of the whole platform. Missing for 10: first-party docs that advertise or explain the spec download, and evidence of how fully the spec covers the REST API.
